name: Erlebnispark Familienland PillerseeTal
kurzbeschreibung: Erlebnispark Familienland in St. Jakob in Haus: over 50 attractions, Austria's highest family roller coaster, pirate ship, and Dead Sea salt grotto.
beschreibung:
Overview

The long-established Erlebnispark Familienland PillerseeTal is idyllically situated at the foot of the Buchensteinwand in the sunny municipality of St. Jakob in Haus (Kitzbühel district) at an altitude of approximately 855 metres. Spanning an expansive area of over 20,000 square metres, this privately run amusement and adventure park brings together more than 50 varied rides, adventure playgrounds, and relaxation zones. As one of the most versatile theme parks in Tyrol, it offers action-packed experiences for toddlers, teenagers, and adults set against the picturesque mountain backdrop of the Pillerseetal.

Route & Requirements

The park's unmistakable flagship and star attraction is the spectacular family roller coaster “Big Bang”: with a track height of 22 metres and top speeds of up to 80 km/h, it is considered the highest roller coaster of its kind in western Austria, delivering pure thrills for the entire family. Other perennial favourites include the swinging Piratenschiff (pirate ship), the fast-paced wild water rafting ride, a wave swinger carousel, go-kart tracks, trampolines, and a large indoor climbing hall with over 600 m² of climbing walls. Unique in the Alps is the adjacent Totes-Meer-Salzgrotte (Dead Sea salt grotto): built using more than 40 tonnes of genuine natural crystal salt from the Dead Sea and the Himalayas, the grotto features a healing microclimate of ionised, mineral-rich air. Accompanied by gentle lighting and soothing ambient music, visitors inhale the beneficial brine, proven to clear the airways, ease allergies, and promote deep relaxation. A petting zoo with pygmy goats, rabbits, and ponies rounds off the family-focused experience.

Visit & Arrival

Erlebnispark Familienland is open daily from early May to mid-October from 10:00 to 18:00 (rides operate until 17:30; operations may be subject to weather conditions in heavy storms). Admission prices (2025/2026 season): day ticket for adults and teenagers from 130 cm height approx. €24.00, children from 3 years up to 130 cm approx. €21.00, children under 3 enter free; family combo tickets are available (a small surcharge applies for using the salt grotto). Holders of the regional PillerseeTal Card receive a discount. By car: via the B164 to Fieberbrunn or St. Johann in Tirol, then along the L347 regional road directly to St. Jakob in Haus; ample free parking is provided right at the park entrance (Mühlau 29). By public transport: ÖBB trains to Fieberbrunn or Hochfilzen station, from where the regional PillerseeTal postbus connects directly to the St. Jakob in Haus Erlebnispark stop.

Tips

The entire park grounds are flat and reliably barrier-free for wheelchair users and pushchairs (the salt cave is also accessible without steps). Plan at least half a day for your visit. The on-site restaurant with its sunny terrace serves child-friendly meals, pizza, and homemade ice cream at reasonable prices.

oeffnungszeiten: Mai bis Okt täglich 10:00–18:00 Uhr (Fahrgeschäfte bis 17:30 Uhr)
